ability:ambush: At the start of a space combat: You may roll 1 die for each of up to 2 of your cruisers or destroyers in the system. For each result equal to or greater than that ship's combat value, produce 1 hit; your opponent must assign it to 1 of their ships.
ability:analytical: When you research a technology that is not a unit upgrade technology: You may ignore 1 prerequisite.
ability:arbiters: When you are negotiating a transaction, action cards can be exchanged as part of that transaction.
ability:armada: The maximum number of non-fighter ships you can have in each system is equal to 2 more than the number of tokens in your fleet pool
ability:assimilate: When you gain control of a planet: Replace each PDS and space dock that is on that planet with a matching unit from your reinforcements.
ability:blood_ties: You do not have to spend influence to remove the custodians token from Mecatol Rex.
ability:brilliant: When you spend a command token to resolve the secondary ability of the "Technology" strategy card: You may resolve the primary ability instead.
ability:crafty: You can have any number of action cards in your hand. Game effects cannot prevent you from using this ability.
ability:creuss_gate: When you create the game board, place the Creuss Gate (tile 17) where your home system would normally be placed. The Creuss Gate system is not a home system. Then, place your home system (tile 51) in your play area.
ability:devotion: After each space combat round: You may destroy 1 of your cruisers or destroyers in the active system to produce 1 hit and assign it to 1 of your opponent's ships in that system.
ability:foresight: After another player moves ships into a system that contains 1 or more of your ships: You may place 1 token from your strategy pool in an adjacent system that does not contain another player's ships; move your ships from the active system into that system.
ability:fragile: Apply -1 to the result of each of your unit's combat rolls.
ability:galactic_threat:
You cannot vote on agendas
Once per agenda phase, after an agenda is revealed: You may predict aloud the outcome of that agenda. If your prediction is correct, gain 1 technology that is owned by a player who voted how you predicted.
ability:gashlai_physiology: Your ships can move through supernovas
ability:guild_ships: You can negotiate transactions with players who are not your neighbor.
ability:harrow: At the end of each round of ground combat: Your ships in the active system may use their BOMBARDMENT abilities against your opponent's ground forces on the planet.
ability:indoctrination: At the start of a ground combat: You may spend 2 influence to replace 1 of your opponent's participating infantry with 1 infantry from your reinforcements.
ability:master_of_trade: You do not have to spend a command token to resolve the secondary ability of the "Trade" strategy card.
ability:mitosis:
Your space docks cannot produce infantry
At the start of the status phase: Place 1 infantry from your reinforcements on any planet you control.
ability:munitions: At the start of each round of space combat: You may spend 2 trade goods to re-roll any number of your dice during that combat round.
ability:nomadic: You can score objectives even if you do not control the planets in your home system.
ability:orbital_drop: ACTION: Spend 1 token from your strategy pool to place 2 infantry from your reinforcements on 1 planet you control.
ability:peace_accords: After you resolve the primary or secondary ability of the "Diplomacy" strategy card: You may gain control of 1 planet other than Mecatol Rex that does not contain any units and is in a system that is adjacent to a planet you control.
ability:pillage: After 1 of your neighbors gains trade goods or resolves a transaction: If they have 3 or more trade goods, you may take 1 of their trade goods or commodities.
ability:propagation:
You cannot research technology
When you would research a technology: Gain 3 command tokens instead.
ability:quantum_entanglement: You treat all systems that contain either an alpha or beta wormhole as adjacent to each other. Game effects cannot prevent you from using this ability.
ability:quash: When an agenda is revealed: You may spend 1 token from your strategy pool to discard that agenda and reveal 1 agenda from the top of the deck. Players vote on this agenda instead.
ability:reclamation: After you resolve a tactical action during which you gained control of Mecatol Rex: You may place 1 PDS and 1 space dock from your reinforcements on Mecatol Rex.
ability:scavenge: After you gain control of a planet: Gain 1 trade good.
ability:scheming: When you draw 1 or more action cards: Draw 1 additional action card. Then, choose and discard 1 action card from your hand.
ability:slipstream: During your tactical actions: Apply +1 to the move value of each of your ships that starts its movement in your home system or in a system that contains either an alpha or beta wormhole.
ability:stall_tactics: ACTION: Discard 1 action card from your hand
ability:star_forge: ACTION: Spend 1 token from your strategy pool to place either 2 fighters or 1 destroyer from your reinforcements in a system that contains 1 or more of your war suns.
ability:technological_singularity: Once per combat, after 1 of your opponent's units is destroyed: You may gain 1 technology that is owned by that player.
ability:telepathic: At the end of the strategy phase: Place the Naalu "0" token on your strategy card; you are first in initiative order.
ability:unrelenting: Apply +1 to the result of each of your unit's combat rolls.
ability:versatile: When you gain command tokens during the status phase: Gain 1 additional command token.
actionCard:abs: Choose 1 player. Exhaust each cultural planet owned by that player.
actionCard:assassin: Choose 1 player. That player cannot vote on this agenda.
actionCard:bribery: Spend any number of trade goods. For each trade good spent, cast 1 additional vote for the outcome on which you voted.
actionCard:bunker: During this invasion, apply -4 to the result of each BOMBARDMENT roll against planets you control.
actionCard:confusing: Choose 1 player. That player is the elected player instead.
actionCard:const_rider: You cannot vote on this agenda. Predict aloud an outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, place 1 space dock from your reinforcements on a planet you control.
actionCard:courageous: Roll 2 dice. For each result equal to or greater than that ship's combat value, your opponent must choose and destroy 1 of their ships.
actionCard:cripple: Choose 1 planet. Destroy each PDS on that planet.
actionCard:diplo_rider: You cannot vote on this agenda. Predict aloud an outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, choose 1 system that contains a planet you control. Each other player places a command token from their reinforcements in that system.
actionCard:disable: Your opponents' PDS units lose PLANETARY SHIELD and SPACE CANNON during this invasion.
actionCard:disgrace: That player must choose a different strategy card instead, if able.
actionCard:distinguished: Cast 5 additional votes for that outcome.
actionCard:economic_initiative: Ready each cultural planet you control.
actionCard:emergency: Repair all of your units that have SUSTAIN DAMAGE in the active system.
actionCard:experimental: Choose 1 of your space docks that is either in or adjacent to that system. That space dock uses SPACE CANNON 5(x3) against the active player's ships in the active system.
actionCard:f_deployment: Place 3 infantry from your reinforcements on 1 planet you control.
actionCard:f_prototype: Apply +2 to the result of each of your fighters' combat rolls during this combat round.
actionCard:f_researched: Spend 4 trade goods to research 1 technology
actionCard:fire_team: Reroll any number of your dice.
actionCard:fs1: Apply +1 to the move value of each of your ships during this tactical action.
actionCard:ghost_ship: Place 1 destroyer from your reinforcements in a non-home system that contains a wormhole and does not contain other players' ships.
actionCard:imp_rider: You cannot vote on this agenda. Predict aloud an outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, gain 1 victory point.
actionCard:industrial_initiative: Gain 1 trade good for each industrial planet you control.
actionCard:infiltrate: Replace each PDS and space dock that is on that planet with a matching unit from your reinforcements.
actionCard:insub: Remove 1 token from another player's tactic pool and return it to their reinforcements.
actionCard:intercept: Your opponent cannot retreat during this round of space combat.
actionCard:jamming: Choose 1 non-home system that contains or is adjacent to 1 of your ships. Place a command token from another player's reinforcements in that system.
actionCard:lead_rider: You cannot vote on this agenda. Predict aloud an outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, gain 3 command tokens.
actionCard:lost_star: During this tactical action, systems that contain alpha and beta wormholes are adjacent to each other.
actionCard:lucky: Destroy 1 dreadnought, cruiser, or destroyer in a system that contains a planet you control.
actionCard:mb1: Apply +1 to the result of each of your unit's combat rolls during this combat round.
actionCard:meltdown: Destroy 1 space dock in a non-home system.
actionCard:messiah: Place 1 infantry from your reinforcements on each planet you control.
actionCard:mining_initiative: Gain trade goods equal to the resource value of 1 planet you control.
actionCard:parley: Return the committed units to the space area.
actionCard:plague: Choose 1 planet that is controlled by another player. Roll 1 die for each infantry on that planet. For each result of 6 or greater, destroy 1 of those units.
actionCard:politic_rider: You cannot vote on this agenda. Predict aloud an outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, draw 3 action cards and gain the speaker token.
actionCard:reparations: Exhaust 1 planet that player controls and ready 1 planet you control.
actionCard:s_retreat1: Move all of your ships from the active system into an adjacent system that does not contain another player's ships. The space combat ends in a draw. Then, place a command token from your reinforcements in that system.
actionCard:salvage: Your opponent gives you all of their commodities.
actionCard:silence_space: Choose 1 system. During this tactical action, your ships in the chosen system can move through systems that contain other players' ships.
actionCard:spy: Choose 1 player. That player gives you 1 random action card from their hand.
actionCard:stability: Do not return your strategy card(s). You do not choose strategy cards during the next strategy phase.
actionCard:tactical: Choose 1 system that contains 1 or more of your units that have BOMBARDMENT. Exhaust each planet controlled by other players in that system.
actionCard:tech_rider: You cannot vote on this agenda. Predict aloud an outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, research 1 technology.
actionCard:trade_rider: You cannot vote on this agenda. Predict aloud an outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, gain 5 trade goods.
actionCard:unexpected: Remove 1 of your command tokens from the game board and return it to your reinforcements.
actionCard:unstable: Choose 1 hazardous planet. Exhaust that planet and destroy up to 3 infantry on it.
actionCard:upgrade: Replace 1 of your cruisers in that system with 1 dreadnought from your reinforcements.
actionCard:uprising: Exhaust 1 non-home planet controlled by another player. Then gain trade goods equal to its resource value.
actionCard:veto: Discard that agenda and reveal 1 agenda from the top of the deck. Players vote on this agenda instead.
actionCard:war_effort: Place 1 cruiser from your reinforcements in a system that contains 1 or more of your ships.
actionCard:war_rider: You cannot vote on this agenda. Predict aloud an outcome of this agenda. If your prediction is correct, place 1 dreadnought from your reinforcements in a system that contains 1 or more of your ships.
agenda:abolishment: Discard the elected law from play.
agenda:arbiter: The elected player gains this card. At the end of the strategy phase, the owner of this card may discard this card to swap 1 of their strategy cards with 1 of another player's strategy cards.
agenda:arms_reduction:
For: Each player destroys all but 2 of their dreadnoughts and all but 4 of their cruisers.
Against: At the start of the next strategy phase, each player exhausts each of their planets that have a technology specialty.
agenda:artifact:
For: The speaker rolls 1 die. If the result is 6-10, each player may research 2 technologies. If the result is 1-5, destroy all units in Mecatol Rex's system, and each player with units in systems adjacent to Mecatol Rex's system destroys 3 of their own units in each of those systems.
Against: No effect.
agenda:classified: The elected secret objective becomes a public objective - place it near the other public objectives in the common play area.
agenda:committee: The elected player gains this card. Before players vote on an agenda that requires a player to be elected, the owner of this card may discard this card to choose a player to be elected. Players do not vote on that agenda.
agenda:conscription:
For: When a player produces units, they produce only 1 fighter and infantry for its cost instead of 2.
Against: No effect.
agenda:constitution:
(When this agenda is revealed, if there are no laws in play, discard this card and reveal another agenda from the top of the deck.) For: Discard all laws from play. At the start of the next strategy phase, each player exhausts each planet in their home system.
Against: No effect.
agenda:conventions:
For: Players cannot use BOMBARDMENT against units that are on cultural planets.
Against: Each player that voted "Against" discards all of their action cards.
agenda:core_mining: Attach this card to the elected planet's card. Then, destroy 1 infantry on the planet. The resource value of this planet is increased by 2.
agenda:crown_of_emphidia: The elected player gains this card and 1 victory point. A player gains this card and 1 victory point after they gain control of a planet in the home system of this card's owner. Then, the previous owner of this card loses 1 victory point.
agenda:crown_of_thalnos: The elected player gains this card. During each combat round, the owner of this card may reroll any number of dice; they must destroy each of their units that did not produce a hit with its reroll.
agenda:defense_act:
For: Each player can have any number of PDS units on planets they control.
Against: Each player destroys 1 of their PDS units.
agenda:demilitarized_zone: Attach this card to the elected planet's card. Then, destroy all units on that planet. Player's units cannot land, be produced, or be placed on this planet.
agenda:disarmament: Destroy each ground force on the elected planet. For each unit that was destroyed, the player who control that planet gains 1 trade good.
agenda:economic_equality:
For: Each player returns all of their trade goods to the supply. Then, each player gains 5 trade goods.
Against: Each player returns all of their trade goods to the supply.
agenda:execution: The elected player discards all of their action cards. If they have the speaker token, they give it to the player on their left. The elected player cannot vote on any agendas during this agenda phase.
agenda:holy_planet_of_ixth: Attach this card to the elected planet's card. The planet's owner gains 1 victory point. Units on this planet cannot use PRODUCTION. When a player gains control of this planet, they gain 1 victory point. When a player loses control of this planet, they lose 1 victory point.
agenda:incentive:
For: Draw and reveal 1 stage I public objective from the deck and place it near the public objectives.
Against: Draw and reveal 1 stage II public from the deck and place it near the public objectives.
agenda:minister_commerce: The elected player gains this card. After the owner of this card replenishes commodities, they gain 1 trade good for each player that is their neighbor.
agenda:minister_exploration: The elected player gains this card. When the owner of this card gains control of a planet, they gain 1 trade good.
agenda:minister_industry: The elected player gains this card. When the owner of this card places a space dock in a system, their units in that system may use their PRODUCTION abilities.
agenda:minister_peace: The elected player gains this card. After a player activates a system that contains 1 or more of a different player's units, the owner of this card may discard this card - immediately end the active player's turn.
agenda:minister_policy: The elected player gains this card. At the end of the status phase, the owner of this card draws 1 action card.
agenda:minister_sciences: The elected player gains this card. When the owner of this card resolves the primary or secondary ability of the "Technology" strategy card, they do not need to spend resources to research technology.
agenda:minister_war: The elected player gains this card. The owner of this card may discard this card after performing an action to remove 1 of their command tokens from the game board and return it to their reinforcements - then they may perform 1 additional action.
agenda:miscount: (When this agenda is revealed, if there are no laws in play, discard this card and reveal another agenda from the top of the deck.) Vote on the elected law as if it were just revealed from the top of the deck.
agenda:mutiny:
For: Each player that voted "For" gains 1 victory point.
Against: Each player that voted "For" loses 1 victory point.
agenda:plowshares:
For: Each player destroys half of their infantry on each planet they control, rounded up. Then, each player gains trade goods equal to the number of their infantry that were destroyed.
Against: Each player places 1 infantry from their reinforcements on each planet they control.
agenda:prophecy: The elected player gains this card. The owner of this card applies +1 to the result of their fighter's combat rolls. When the owner of this card uses PRODUCTION, they discard this card unless they produce 2 or more fighters.
agenda:redistribution: Destroy each unit on the elected planet. Then, the player who controls that planet chooses 1 player with the fewest victory points - that player may place 1 infantry from their reinforcements on that planet.
agenda:regulations:
For: Each player cannot have more than 4 tokens in their fleet pool.
Against: Each player places 1 command token from their reinforcements in their fleet pool.
agenda:representative_government:
For: Players cannot exhaust planets to cast votes during the agenda phase. Each player may cast 1 vote on each agenda instead.
Against: At the start of the next strategy phase, each player that voted "Against" exhausts all of their cultural planets.
agenda:revolution:
For: After a player researches a technology, that player must destroy 1 of their non-fighter ships.
Against: At the start of the next strategy phase, each player chooses and exhausts 1 planet for each technology that they own.
agenda:rt_biotic: Attach this card to the elected planet's card. When the owner of this planet researches technology, they may exhaust this card to ignore 1 green prerequisite.
agenda:rt_cybernetic: Attach this card to the elected planet's card. When the owner of this planet researches technology, they may exhaust this card to ignore 1 yellow prerequisite.
agenda:rt_propulsion: Attach this card to the elected planet's card. When the owner of this planet researches technology, they may exhaust this card to ignore 1 blue prerequisite.
agenda:rt_warfare: Attach this card to the elected planet's card. When the owner of this planet researches technology, they may exhaust this card to ignore 1 red prerequisite.
agenda:sanctions:
For: Each player can have a maximum of 3 action cards in their hand.
Against: Each player discards 1 random action card from their hand.
agenda:schematics:
For: If any player owns a war sun technology, all players may ignore all prerequisites on war sun technologies. All war suns lose SUSTAIN DAMAGE.
Against: Each player that owns a war sun technology discards all of their action cards.
agenda:secret: The elected player draws 1 secret objective.
agenda:seed_empire:
For: The player with the most victory points gains 1 victory point.
Against: The player with the fewest victory points gains 1 victory point.
agenda:senate_sanctuary: Attach this card to the elected planet's card. The influence value of this planet is increased by 2.
agenda:shard_of_the_throne: The elected player gains this card and 1 victory point. A player gains this card and 1 victory point when they win a combat against the owner of this card. Then, the previous owner of this card loses 1 victory point.
agenda:shared_research:
For: Each player's units can move through nebulae.
Against: Each player places a command token from their reinforcements in their home system, if able.
agenda:terraforming_initiative: Attach this card to the elected planet's card. The resource and influence values of this planet are increased by 1.
agenda:travel_ban:
For: Alpha and beta wormholes have no effect during movement.
Against: Destroy each PDS in or adjacent to a system that contains a wormhole.
agenda:unconventional:
For: Each player that voted "For" draws 2 action cards.
Against: Each player that voted "For" discards all of their action cards.
agenda:wormhole_recon:
For: All systems that contain either an alpha or beta wormhole are adjacent to each other.
Against: Each player places a command token from their reinforcements in each system that contains a wormhole and 1 or more of their ships.
agenda:wormhole_research:
For: Each player who has 1 or more ships in a system that contains a wormhole may research 1 technology. Then, destroy all ships in systems that contain an alpha or beta wormhole.
Against: Each player that voted "Against" removes 1 command token from their command sheet and returns it to their reinforcements.
promissory:<color>_cf: After the <color> player activates a system that contains 1 or more of your units: The <color> player cannot move units to the active system. Then return this card to the <color> player.
promissory:<color>_ps: When an agenda is revealed: The <color> player cannot vote, play action cards, or use faction abilities until after that agenda has been resolved. Then, return this card to the <color> player.
promissory:<color>_sftt: When you receive this card, if you are not the <color> player, you must place it faceup in your play area and gain 1 victory point. When you activate a system that contains 1 or more of the <color> player's units, or if the <color> player is eliminated, lose 1 victory point and return this card to the <color> player.
promissory:<color>_ta: When the <color> player replenishes commodities: The <color> player gives you all of their commodities. Then, return this card to the <color> player.
promissory:acq: When the Winnu player resolves a strategic action: You do not have to spend or place a command token to resolve the secondary ability of that strategy card. Then, return this card to the Winnu player.
promissory:antivirus: At the start of a combat: Place this card faceup in your play area. While this card is in your play area, the Nekro player cannot use their Technological Singularity faction ability against you. If you activate a system that contains 1 or more of the Nekro player's units, return this card to the Nekro player.
promissory:ce: When you gain command tokens during the status phase: Gain 1 additional command token. Then, return this card to the L1Z1X player.
promissory:convoys: ACTION: Place this card faceup in your play area. While this card is in your play area, you may negotiate transactions with players who are not your neighbor.  If you activate a system that contains 1 or more of the Hacan player's units, return this card to the Hacan player.
promissory:favor: When an agenda is revealed: Remove 1 token from the Xxcha player's strategy pool and return it to their reinforcements. Then, discard the revealed agenda and reveal 1 agenda from the top of the deck. Players vote on this agenda instead. Then, return this card to the Xxcha player.
promissory:fires: ACTION: Remove 1 token from the Muaat player's fleet pool and return it to their reinforcements. Then, gain your war sun unit upgrade technology card.  Then, return this card to the Muaat Player.
promissory:gift: At the end of the Strategy Phase: Place this card faceup in your play area and place the Naalu '0' token on your strategy card, you are the first in initiative order. The Naalu player cannot use their Telepathic faction ability during this game round. Return this card to the Naalu player at the end of the status phase.
promissory:greyfire: At the start of a ground combat against 2 or more ground forces that are not controlled by the Yin player: Replace 1 of your opponent's infantry with 1 infantry from your reinforcements. Then, return this card to the Yin player.
promissory:iff: At the start of your turn during the action phase: Place or move a Creuss wormhole token into either a system that contains a planet you control or a non-home system that does not contain another player's ships. Then, return this card to the Creuss player.
promissory:ms: At the start of the Sol player's turn: Remove 1 token from the Sol player's strategy pool, if able, and return it to their reinforcements. Then, you may place 2 infantry from your reinforcements on any planet you control. Then, return this card to the Sol player.
promissory:pop: ACTION: Place this card faceup in your play area. While this card is in your play area, the Mentak player cannot use their Pillage faction ability against you. If you activate a system that contains 1 or more of the Mentak player's units, return this card to the Mentak player.
promissory:ra: After the Jol-Nar player researches a technology that is not a faction technology: Gain that technology. Then, return this card to the Jol-Nar player.
promissory:ragh: After you commit 1 or more units to land on a planet: Remove all of the Saar player's ground forces from that planet and place them on a planet controlled by the Saar player. Then, return this card to the Saar player.
promissory:spynet: At the start of your turn: Look at the Yssaril player's hand of action cards. Choose 1 of those cards and add it to your hand. Then, return this card to the Yssaril player.
promissory:stymie: After another player moves ships into a system that contains 1 or more of your units: You may place 1 command token from that player's reinforcements in any non-home system. Then, return this card to the Arborec player.
promissory:tekklar: At the start of an invasion combat: Apply +1 to the result of each of your unit's combat rolls during this combat. If your opponent is the N'orr player, apply -1 to the result of each of their unit's combat rolls during this combat. Then, return this card to the N'orr player.
promissory:war_funding: After you and your opponent roll dice during space combat: You may reroll all of your opponent's dice. You may reroll any number of your dice. Then, return this card to the Letnev player.
publicObjective:brain_trust: Control 5 planets that have technology specialties.
publicObjective:conquer: Control 1 planet that is in another player's home system.
publicObjective:corner: Control 4 planets that each have the same planet trait.
publicObjective:diversify: Own 2 technologies in each of 2 colors.
publicObjective:galvanize: Spend a total of 6 tokens from your tactic and/or strategy pools.
publicObjective:intimidate: Have 1 or more ships in 2 systems that are adjacent to Mecatol Rex's system.
publicObjective:lead: Spend a total of 3 tokens from your tactic and/or strategy pools.
publicObjective:master_science: Own 2 technologies in each of 4 colors.
publicObjective:research_outposts: Control 3 planets that have technology specialties.
publicObjective:unify_colonies: Control 6 planets that each have the same planet trait.
secretObjective:ans: Own 2 faction technologies. 'Valefar Assimilator' technologies do not count toward this objective.
secretObjective:btgk: Have 1 or more ships in a system that contains an alpha wormhole and 1 or more ships in a system that contains a beta wormhole.
secretObjective:csl: Have 1 or more ships in the same system as another player's space dock.
secretObjective:ctr: Have 1 or more ships in 6 systems.
secretObjective:dtgs: Destroy another player's war sun or flagship.
secretObjective:eap: Have 4 PDS units on the game board.
secretObjective:fwm: Have 3 space docks on the game board.
secretObjective:gamf: Have 5 dreadnoughts on the game board.
secretObjective:lsc: Have 1 or more ships in 3 systems that are each adjacent to an anomaly.
secretObjective:mew: Destroy the last of a player's ground forces on a planet during the bombardment step.
secretObjective:mlp: Own 4 technologies of the same color.
secretObjective:ose: Control Mecatol Rex and have 3 or more ships in its system.
secretObjective:sar: Win a combat against a player who has the most victory points.
secretObjective:te: Have 1 or more ships in a system that is adjacent to another player's home system.
secretObjective:ttfd: Destroy the last of a player's non-fighter ships in the active system during the space cannon offense step.
secretObjective:uf: Win a space combat in a system that contains your flagship. You cannot score this objective if your flagship is destroyed in the combat.
strategy:base2:
Choose 1 system other than the Mecatol Rex system that contains a planet you control; each other player places a command token from their reinforcements in the chosen system.
Then, ready each exhausted planet you control in that system.
strategy:base2#secondary: Spend 1 token from your strategy pool to ready up to 2 exhausted planets
strategy:base4:
Place 1 PDS or 1 Space Dock on a planet you control.
Place 1 PDS on a planet you control.
strategy:base4#secondary: Place 1 token from your strategy pool in any system; you may place either 1 space dock or 1 PDS on a planet you control in that system.
strategy:pok1leadership:
Gain 3 command tokens
Spend any amount of influence to gain 1 command token for every 3 influence spent
strategy:pok1leadership#secondary: Spend any amount of influence to gain 1 command token for every 3 influence spent
strategy:pok3politics:
Choose a player other than the speaker.  That player gains the speaker token.
Draw 2 action cards
Look at the top 2 cards of the agenda deck. Place each card on the top or bottom of the deck in any order.
strategy:pok3politics#secondary: Spend 1 token from your strategy pool to draw 2 action cards.
strategy:pok5trade:
Gain 3 trade goods.
Replenish commodities.
Choose any number of other players. Those players use the secondary ability of this strategy card without spending a command token.
strategy:pok5trade#secondary: Spend 1 token from your strategy pool to replenish your commodities.
strategy:pok6warfare:
Remove 1 of your command tokens from the game board; then, gain 1 command token.
Redistribute any number of the command tokens on your command sheet.
strategy:pok6warfare#secondary: Spend 1 token from your strategy pool to use the PRODUCTION ability of 1 of your space docks in your home system (this token is not placed in your home system).
strategy:pok7technology:
Research 1 technology.
Spend 6 resources to research 1 technology.
strategy:pok7technology#secondary: Spend 1 token from your strategy pool and 4 resources to research 1 technology.
strategy:pok8imperial:
Immediately score 1 public objective if you fulfill its requirements.
Gain 1 victory point if you control Mecatol Rex; otherwise, draw 1 secret objective.
strategy:pok8imperial#secondary: Spend 1 token from your strategy pool to draw 1 secret objective.
technology:ac2:
Cost 3, Combat 9, Move 2, Capacity 8
SUSTAIN DAMAGE
technology:aida:
When you research a unit upgrade technology, you may exhaust this card to ignore any 1 prerequisite.
When 1 or more of your units use PRODUCTION, you may exhaust this card to reduce the combined cost of the produced units by the number of unit upgrade technologies that you own.
technology:amd:
Your ships can move into and through asteroid fields.
